glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 言 + phonetic 兌.
senses: [shuì] to persuade; to canvass; to lobby
[shuì] (Quanzhou Hokkien) to swindle; to defraud; to cheat out of
[yuè] (obsolete in standard Chinese) alternative form of 悅 (“happy; delighted”)
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 說; s_page_origin explains the simplified 说.
